visualCharacteristics.purpose: Accordion of feature items with optional leading icons, beside an image that follows the open item

contentPattern.structure: Item rows: cell 1 = title (optional leading icon), cell 2 = body, optional cell 3 = image shown while that item is open. Single-cell rows before the items are an intro (heading/text), after the items a footer (e.g. "See all" link); a single-cell image-only row is a shared side image

usage: Feature and benefit lists with icons and imagery on product and office pages.
reuseGuidance: Use link-list for two columns of items without imagery, checklist when item bodies are check-marked lists. Plain FAQs belong in accordion-faq. Background colour is set by section metadata Style.
